title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Platform
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is understood, trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform.
   

  

 As the scale and diversity of content continue to grow—driven by advances in AI, new creation tools, and emerging content formats—we’re investing in intelligent systems that can understand, evaluate, manage, and route content reliably at global scale.
   

  

 We’re hiring Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineers to build and scale foundational ML systems that power content understanding, safety, policy enforcement, and decisioning across Spotify. Depending on your experience and interests, you may focus on areas ranging from multimodal content understanding and platform-level ML systems to safety, risk detection, policy enforcement, and compliance.
   

  

 You’ll help shape the architecture and technical strategy behind how Spotify understands and makes decisions about content at global scale. This work is foundational to delivering safe, high-quality experiences for listeners and creators while enabling new ways for people to interact with content across Spotify.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Define and drive machine learning strategy across content understanding, safety, policy enforcement, and platform-level decisioning
* Build and scale production ML systems for classification, moderation, ranking, risk detection, and content evaluation
* Develop automated decisioning systems that support content quality, integrity, safety, and policy compliance at scale
* Design and deploy ML systems across multiple content modalities, including text, audio, image, and video
* Build systems capable of evaluating and making decisions about content in real time and at Spotify scale
* Enable controlled and reliable access to content and metadata for downstream products and applications
* Collaborate closely with Product, Policy, Trust & Safety, and Engineering teams to translate content standards into scalable technical solutions
* Advance automation while maintaining high standards for quality, safety, fairness, explainability, and reliability
* Provide technical leadership across teams, mentoring engineers and influencing ML engineering, evaluation, and system design best practices


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have significant experience designing and building production-grade machine learning systems at scale
* You have deep experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or similar
* You have experience with—or a strong interest in—multimodal machine learning across areas such as text, audio, image, or video
* You have built systems where machine learning outputs inform or automate real-world decisions
* You understand how to balance automation with quality, safety, reliability, and user experience
* You’re comfortable tackling complex and ambiguous technical problems with significant product and business impact
* You think in systems, connecting models, data, infrastructure, and decisioning to platform-level outcomes and user experiences
* You care deeply about data quality, rigorous evaluation, fairness, explainability, and system reliability
* You’re an experienced technical leader who communicates clearly, mentors others, and can influence across technical and non-technical teams


 Where You Will Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

title: Base Station Senior Technical Expert
description:
At TÜV SÜD Group we are passionate about technology. Innovations impact our daily lives in countless ways, and we are dedicated to being a part of that progress. We test, we audit, we inspect, we advise. We never stop challenging ourselves for the safety of society and its people. We breathe technology, we strive for professional excellence, and we leave a mark. We take the future into our hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Working as part of a team of Base Station Test Engineers, the applicant will contribute to the provision of a Base Station testing service, specifically performing RF (Radio Frequency) ETSI / 3GPP / FCC / ISED testing state of the art wireless technologies, such as Base Station Infrastructure (GSM / W-CDMA / LTE / NR).
   

  

 This role is based on-site and full time in Kista, Sweden. The successful candidate will be required to ensure that work is completed to the required level of quality in line with customer expectations and accreditation requirements, (SWEDAC and UKAS). Occasional travel is required for training and to cover off-site testing activities both inside and outside of Sweden. The successful candidate will be required to support activities in other global regions, which are currently China and Canada.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Assisting with the technical correctness of reports, Test Information Document, (TID) and Test Plans.
* Key contact point and technical expert for the manufacturer in Sweden, China and Canada.
* Act as a Report Signatory for reports generated by the test team.
* Ensure all activities are carried out in accordance with ISO 17025.
* Support with testing where required.
* Calculation and update of Measurement Uncertainties.
* Validation of test software used by TUV SUD and the manufacturer.
* Support the introduction of new services as required by the manufacturer – examples might be FR2 OTA, 6G
* Assist with authoring technical justifications in cases where deviations to standards are required.
* Development of test plans in conjunction with the manufacturer including test reduction rationale.
* Communicate with technical experts and project managers to determine test strategies in line with regulatory requirements.
* Attend both projects and technical meetings with the manufacturer providing feedback to the test team on information pertinent to ongoing and future projects.
* Provide training to the manufacturer and other interested parties on Regulatory requirements.
* Oversee internal document and software tools in line with 3Gpp/ETSI and FCC requirements.


**Essential Criteria**
* Educated to HND level (or equivalent) in Engineering with a RF / Radio content.
* Experience and working knowledge of 3GPP test standards for Cellular equipment – particularly 4G/5G.
* A good understanding of digital communications technologies.
* An interest in working in a test environment.
* Motivated and enthusiastic, with a willingness to increase knowledge as technology advances.
* Flexible approach to work – willing to work shift/overtime as required.
* Strong understanding of using IT systems such as MS Word, Excel and Outlook.
* Ability to deliver work independently or as a team, to defined deadlines.
* Conscientious with good interpersonal, customer skills and commercial awareness.


**Desirable Criteria**
* Experience gained in performing RF accredited testing on a large variety of Wireless technologies, such as WLAN 802.11, Bluetooth, Zigbee, Base Station (GSM / W-CDMA / LTE), SRD 433/868MHz etc.
* Experience of using RF test equipment such as Spectrum/network Analyser, Signal generator, RF Power meter, Base Station test set etc
* Knowledge of EU and FCC Regulatory requirements
* Software skills such as VBA, C Sharp

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Major Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. \* You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks Is Leading The Charge In Platformization, Offering Best-in-breed Solutions That Enable Customers To Build a Truly Zero-trust Security Architecture And Navigate Critical Transformations. To Ensure Our Sales Team Is Equipped To Guide Customers, We've Developed FLIGHT, An Immersive Onboarding Program
   

  

 Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions.
   

  

 This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

* As a Major Account Manager, you will drive and orchestrate large complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer.
* Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers.
* Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions.
* Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan.
* Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.
* Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services.
* Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions
* Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
* Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meetings.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
 Minimum 15 years experience including 6 years in large Enterprise SaaS or IT Security companies
   

  

 Fluent Swedish
   

  

**Preferred**
 Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
   

  

 Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Head of Go-To-Market (Data & AI)
description:
At Capgemini, you have the opportunity to shape your career in a way that fits your life, your goals, and your ambitions; supported by a collaborative team where knowledge sharing and continuous learning are part of everyday work. We believe in reimagining what’s possible and using technology to build a more sustainable and inclusive future. Our Data & AI team leads the way in this mission, delivering end-to-end Data & AI solutions across industries. With over 550 specialists in the Nordics and strong partnerships with Google, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, and Snowflake, and more we scale next‑generation cloud Data & AI with impact. Here, your skills matter, your ideas matter, and your growth matters. Join us and be part of transforming industries with cutting-edge data innovation. We value diverse perspectives and know that innovation happens when people with different backgrounds and experiences come together. We actively encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.
   

  

 Ready to elevate your career? We are now looking for our next Head of Go-To-Market & Larger Deals, Data & AI Sweden, where you will lead a talented team of people and be part of the Capgemini Sweden Data & AI Leadership Team.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

 As Head of Go-To-Market for Data and AI in Sweden, you will lead the Data & AI sales team, driving the development and execution of growth strategies in close collaboration with the Sweden leadership team. You will own the End-To-End Go-To-Market engine, oversee pipeline development, forecasting, and performance management, while shaping and closing large, complex deals. You will define market priorities, build robust business cases, and align industry-focused sales efforts with our portfolio and key partners. In addition, you will have the opportunity to contribute as an expert consultant in selected client engagements, providing hands-on support in delivery when relevant. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues, clients, and teams across the Nordics and Europe.
   

  

*You will play a key role in:*
**Strategic sales leadership & growth**
* Lead Data & AI GTM Team across Sweden in close collaboration with the Sweden MD
* Define and operationalize the Go-To-Market strategy (segmentation, value propositions, use cases)
* Qualify and pursue major opportunities, ensuring alignment with Business Lines and Data & AI offerings
* Drive pipeline growth, strategic deal wins, partner revenue, and market share


**Business development & client engagement**
* Build and maintain strong client relationships and external network
* Address complex client challenges and engage senior stakeholders
* Act as an expert consultant in selected client engagements, contributing to delivery through hands-on support when needed


**Deal execution & partnerships**
* Lead and orchestrate strategic deal shaping from qualification to closure
* Define and execute joint Go-To-Market strategies with partners (co-sell, co-innovation)
* Ensure strong Sales-to-Delivery transition including mobilisation and staffing


**Operations, performance & governance**
* Manage Go-To-Market operations, funnel tracking, reporting, and forecasting
* Ensure accurate forecasts and manage business development costs
* Design and implement performance management (KPIs)
* Support weekly, ad-hoc Sweden & Europe reporting
* Inspire high performance, build a strong sales culture, and act as a role model


 Your profile
   

  

**Enterprise sales expertise & track record**
* Senior-level enterprise sales experience within Data & AI
* Proven track record of leading and closing large, complex transformation deals
* Strong experience in shaping advanced Data & AI services and solutions
* Passion for AI, data & analytics in an enterprise context


**Stakeholder management & influence**
* Strong ability to communicate and influence at senior business levels
* Proven capability to build and maintain relationships with key client stakeholders


**Market Network & Industry Experience**
* Established client network within relevant industries
* Experience across horizontal business functions (e.g. finance, CX, procurement, HR, supply chain)
* Strong experience in at least two key sectors (e.g. Retail, Automotive, FS, Public Sector, etc.)


**Strategic advisory & solutioning capability**
* Ability to understand and shape complex client needs into Data & AI solutions
* Experience aligning solutions to client vision and transformation goals


**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* A unique opportunity to shape Capgemini’s Data & AI growth agenda in Sweden, working closely with senior leadership and influencing some of the largest transformation programs in the market
* Freedom to finetune the role and be the best you can be, ensuring the success of Capgemini in a competitive market
* A culture shaped by Capgemini’s core values: Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Freedom, Team Spirit, Modesty, and Fun, where you actively contribute to bringing these values to life every day
* A comprehensive benefits package, including occupational and flexible pension schemes, private insurance, parental benefits, preventive healthcare and much more


 We are primarily looking for candidates based in Stockholm, but we also welcome your application if you are located in Gothenburg or Malmö.
   

  

**Application**
*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*
**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
   

  

**Make it real** 
 | www.capgemini.com

title: HR Business Analyst – konsultuppdrag
description:

 **HR, verksamhet och system** 
 och vara med och forma framtidens HR-processer i en större organisation?
   

  

 Vi på
 **HIRED**

 **HR Business Analyst**

 **anställd konsult hos HIRED**

 **fakturera via eget bolag**

 Du blir involverad genom hela transformationsresan – från kravinsamling och analys till processdesign, testning, implementation, utrullning och stabilisering.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att kunna strukturera och utmana verksamhetens behov samt skilja mellan
 **faktiska verksamhetskrav, lösningsdesign och teknisk implementation** 
 .

* Bidra vid rollout och stabilisering av den nya lösningen

* Stötta förändringsarbetet och bidra till att nya arbetssätt etableras i organisationen

 Vi söker dig som har

* Flytande svenska och engelska


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**

* Implementation eller byte av större HR-system
* Strukturerade processramverk och processdokumentation
* Change management och förändringsresor kopplade till nya system och arbetssätt

 Du är analytisk, strukturerad och nyfiken och trivs med att skapa tydlighet i komplexa miljöer.

 **legala krav, faktiska verksamhetsbehov och sådant som görs på ett visst sätt av historiska skäl** 
 .

title: Sales Manager Nexus BIX- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Sales Manager Multichannel & BIX - Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**
 Are you ready to make an impact? Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We have a great opportunity available now in our team.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior** 
**Sales Manager to join Tieto Indtech and drive new business growth within our BIX and Multichannel business in Sweden** 
 .
   

  

 This is a
 **new business sales role** 
 . Your primary responsibility will be to identify prospective customers, create and develop opportunities, and lead them from initial engagement through to a signed agreement.
   

  

 You will sell solutions that help organizations digitalize and automate how they exchange invoices and business documents with their customers, suppliers and other business partners. Our offering includes both
 **B2B and B2C invoice and document distribution** 
 , from electronic invoicing and invoice collection to multichannel distribution and related value-added services.
   

  

 You will work with large and mid-sized organizations across different industries and engage with stakeholders in finance, IT, procurement and business operations.
   

  

 In this Sales Manager role, you will be part of the Nordic sales team as opportunities are discovered. You will work closely with colleagues across Sweden and the Nordics, and you will receive training and support based on our shared knowledge and experience from different Nordic markets. We are always open to new ideas and believe continuous development and learning are important, and you will play an important role in our sales development.
   

  

**In your daily work you get to**
* Be Senior Sales Manager focusing on hunting new sales for our services
* Proactively identify and target prospective customers and build a strong pipeline
* Lead generation activities together with marketing
* Participate in events, fairs etc with the purpose of learning more about our customers need and find new leads
* Engage with prospects to understand their invoicing, finance and document distribution processes, identify their challenges and development priorities.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, and contract signing.
* Coordinate, together with Presales and BID-manager, internal experts from product management, solution consulting, delivery, legal, finance and other functions throughout the sales process
* Lead and coordinate responses to RFIs, RFPs and other formal procurement processes
* Bring market and prospect insights back to our product and business teams to support the continued development of our offering and go-to-market approach


**To enjoy working with us in this role, we believe that you:**
* Have solution sales experience, and are used to agile working methods
* Are motivated by creating opportunities and winning new customers
* Come with experience of technology, financial processes, invoicing, ERP, business process services or a related fields
* Have a pro-active attitude and way of working
* Can handle multiple sales processes simultaneously
* Are fluent in Swedish and English


**What Multichannel & BIX Offers You**
 We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture and an outstanding work-life balance! We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge. Tieto offers local proximity with global capabilities. You get to be part of a community of professionals, a community of friends
 **.**
**In addition, we offer:**
* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits, adapted to the Swedish market
* Mobile package and, depending on role and eligibility, company car or related mobility benefits
* Wellness allowance and other local wellbeing initiatives
* Family-friendly policies, including support for work-life balance and parental leave
* Occupational pension, employee discounts, referral bonuses and additional lifestyle benefits


**Join us and make your mark!**
 We look forward to your application!
   

  

 Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact hiring manager Carin Ramsin via e-mail carin.ramsin@tieto.com
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
   

  

 Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto
   

  

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**
* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

title: Account Manager - EMEA
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

 As an Account Manager, you will own the commercial growth of a portfolio of existing Enterprise customers.
   

  

 This is a commercial, quota-carrying growth role. You’ll drive expansion by identifying new opportunities, building pipeline, growing Mentimeter into new teams and use cases, and owning renewals.
   

  

 Strong customer relationships are key to succeeding, but this isn’t about simply managing an existing book of business. We’re looking for someone proactive and commercially driven - someone who gets energy from finding the next opportunity and turning customer value into growth.
   

  

 You’ll have a lot of ownership over how you reach your goals, while partnering closely with Customer Success Managers who focus on helping customers realize value from Mentimeter.
   

  

****Responsibilities For The Role:****
* Own the commercial performance of your Enterprise customer portfolio, including expansion and renewals
* Proactively identify and create upsell and expansion opportunities
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline and deliver against your commercial targets
* Expand relationships into new stakeholders, teams and use cases
* Build long-term customer relationships while maintaining a clear commercial agenda
* Use data and customer insights to prioritize opportunities and manage commercial risks
* Collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers to drive customer value, retention and growth


****What Will Help You Succeed****
 We think you’ll thrive here if you:
   

  

* Have previous SaaS sales experience and experience working towards commercial targets
* Enjoy creating opportunities and building pipeline, not only managing existing relationships
* Have strong discovery, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting skills
* Know how to navigate customer organizations and engage multiple stakeholders
* Are familiar with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC/MEDPIC, SPIN, BANT, Challenger or similar
* Are comfortable managing multiple customers and prioritizing where you can create the most impact
* Communicate clearly and confidently in English


 Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is hungry and humble: ambitious about what you want to achieve and how you want to grow, while being collaborative, curious and generous with the people around you.
   

  

****What Mentimeter Can Offer:****
 Mentimeter is growing, and we have ambitious goals for where we want to go next. You’ll work alongside smart, motivated people who care deeply about what they do, with meaningful ownership and plenty of opportunity to grow your career as the company grows.
   

  

 We’re ambitious, but ambition here doesn’t mean sharp elbows. We want people to challenge themselves, take ownership and keep raising the bar while remaining kind, curious and collaborative. We also believe in sustainable performance and a healthy work-life balance. We want you to be able to do great work, keep developing and build a career here for the long term.
   

  

 You’ll be working on a beloved product used by more than 500 million people, supported by Marketing, Product, Sales Development and Sales Operations teams, as well as professional CRM and data tools
   

  

****Not Required:****
* You don’t have to know Swedish (we are an English-first organization, daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 different nationalities!)


 Please note that this position is located onsite in Stockholm, with the starting date being flexible yet ideally as soon as possible.
   

  

****Compensation At Mentimeter****
 At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.
   

  

 The salary range for this role is SEK 50–60,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.
   

  

 Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.
   

  

 We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
   

  

 In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm
   

  

****What Mentimeter Can Offer****
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.
   

  

 As an Account Manager, you will own the commercial growth of a portfolio of existing Enterprise customers.
   

  

 This is a commercial, quota-carrying growth role. You’ll drive expansion by identifying new opportunities, building pipeline, growing Mentimeter into new teams and use cases, and owning renewals.
   

  

 Strong customer relationships are key to succeeding, but this isn’t about simply managing an existing book of business. We’re looking for someone proactive and commercially driven - someone who gets energy from finding the next opportunity and turning customer value into growth.
   

  

 You’ll have a lot of ownership over how you reach your goals, while partnering closely with Customer Success Managers who focus on helping customers realize value from Mentimeter.
   

  

****Compensation At Mentimeter****
 At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.
   

  

 The salary range for this role is SEK 50–60,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.
   

  

 Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.
   

  

 We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
   

  

 In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm

title: Security Officer tillika biträdande säkerhetsskyddschef
description:
**Vill du utveckla och stärka säkerhetsskyddet i en verksamhet med samhällsviktiga uppdrag?**
 Vi söker nu en erfaren och engagerad
 **Security Officer tillika biträdande säkerhetsskyddschef** 
 som vill vara med och vidareutveckla vårt säkerhetsarbete. I rollen får du arbeta både strategiskt och operativt med säkerhetsskydd, utbildning, processutveckling och samverkan inom organisationen. Du blir en viktig del av säkerhetsfunktionen och ett nära stöd till säkerhetsskyddschefen i det långsiktiga säkerhetsskyddsarbetet.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Security Officer ansvarar du för att säkerställa att verksamhetens säkerhetsskyddsarbete bedrivs i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning, kundkrav och interna styrdokument. Du driver utveckling av rutiner, processer och arbetssätt samtidigt som du fungerar som mentor och specialiststöd för säkerhetsorganisationen. Arbetsplatsen är i Bromma.
   

  

**I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att**
* Planera, följa upp och rapportera utbildningsinsatser inom säkerhetsskydd.
* Genomföra och utveckla egenkontroller kopplade till säkerhetsskyddsavtal och säkerhetsskyddsöverenskommelser.
* Granska och kvalitetssäkra säkerhetsskyddsavtal samt ge rekommendationer inför avtalstecknande.
* Stödja och utbilda verksamheten inom säker informationshantering kopplat till säkerhetsskyddet.
* Utveckla rutiner, checklistor och processer för ett effektivt och långsiktigt säkerhetsskyddsarbete.
* Fungera som mentor för nya och befintliga medarbetare inom säkerhetsfunktionen.
* Vara en central kontaktyta gentemot interna funktioner, kunder och samarbetspartners i säkerhetsrelaterade frågor.
* Samarbeta nära IT- och informationssäkerhetsfunktioner för att stärka organisationens säkerhetskultur.
* Stödja säkerhetsskyddschefen i strategiska frågor och utvecklingsinitiativ.


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som har en stark förmåga att omsätta regelverk och krav till praktiska arbetssätt. Du är van att arbeta självständigt, samtidigt som du trivs i en rådgivande och samverkande roll där du stöttar verksamheten och bygger förtroendefulla relationer.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* Gymnasieutbildning.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet från handläggande roller inom säkerhet (ej bevakning).
* God administrativ förmåga.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.


**Meriterande**
* Yrkesutbildning eller högskoleutbildning inom relevant område.
* Utbildning inom säkerhetsskydd.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är:
   

  

* Strukturerad och noggrann.
* Resultatorienterad och uthållig.
* Samarbetsorienterad med god förmåga att skapa förtroende.
* Hänsynstagande och lyhörd.
* Lösningsorienterad och pragmatisk.
* Analytisk med förmåga att se både detaljer och helhetsperspektiv.


**Vi erbjuder**
**Hos Oss Får Du Möjlighet Att**
* Arbeta med kvalificerade säkerhetsskyddsfrågor i en verksamhet med höga säkerhetskrav.
* Vara med och påverka utvecklingen av organisationens säkerhetsarbete.
* Samarbeta med engagerade kollegor och specialister.
* Jobba i en organisation som genomsyras av förtroende och frihet under ansvar.
* Flexibel arbetsplats med hybrid-funktion där du kan jobba upp till två dagar i veckan på distans
* Generösa förmåner såsom friskvårdsbidrag, bidrag till hemmakontor och sommararbetstid
* En strategiskt viktig roll med stor möjlighet att påverka


*Anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass, vilket i detta fall ställer krav på svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll. Säkerhetsprövningen görs i enlighet med bestämmelser i säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585)* 
**.**
*Som en del av vårt ansvar inom totalförsvaret kan tjänsten komma att krigsplaceras. Detta innebär att du vid höjd beredskap eller krig kommer att kallas in för att upprätthålla Coromatics samhällsviktiga verksamhet kopplad till din befattning. För vissa tjänster kan även bakgrundskontroll komma att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.*
**Ansökan**
**Låter vi som rätt match för dig? Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Har du frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta gärna rekryterande chef Marcus Qvennerstedt på marcus.qvennerstedt@coromatic.se
   

  

 Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen? Kontakta ansvarig Talent Acquisition Specialist, Sabina Sjögren, sabina.sjogren@coromatic.se
   

  

**Bli en del av Coromatic och bidra till ett motståndskraftigt och hållbart samhälle**
*Coromatic säkerställer kontinuerlig kraftförsörjning och datakommunikation 24/7 genom att utveckla, serva och driva robusta fysiska infrastrukturlösningar för datacenter och reservkraft med hållbarhet och säkerhet som kärnan i vår leverans.*
*Sedan starten 1992, och som en del av E.ON-koncernen från 2019, har vi byggt ett starkt förtroende i marknaden. Vi säkrar driften av verksamhetskritisk infrastruktur för organisationer som håller samhället i gång och vi samarbetar med över hälften av Nordens största företag.*
*Bli en del av vårt team med över 800 kollegor på 21 regionala kontor och servicecenter i Norden – och var med på vår resa för att säkra ett motståndskraftigt och hållbart samhälle.*

title: Sales Account Management, Staff
description:
**We Are:**
 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

**You Are:**
 You are a dynamic, results-driven sales professional with a passion for technology and engineering solutions. Your expertise lies in building strong relationships and understanding the unique challenges faced by customers in the engineering and simulation space. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are adept at managing multiple priorities, leveraging your organizational skills to drive sales growth and customer satisfaction. As someone with a technical background, you are comfortable navigating complex sales processes and communicating the value of advanced products to both technical and business stakeholders. You are proactive, resourceful, and eager to learn, always seeking ways to expand your network and deepen your understanding of customer needs. Your strategic mindset enables you to craft and execute effective account plans, while your collaborative spirit ensures you work seamlessly with cross-functional teams. Your fluency in English and Swedish equips you to engage confidently across diverse customer groups, and your willingness to travel means you’re ready to connect with clients wherever they are. Above all, you are committed to delivering exceptional results—helping customers innovate, optimize processes, and achieve measurable ROI with Synopsys solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Establishing, developing, and maintaining business relationships with current and prospective customers within your assigned territory and industry.
* Maintaining renewal business and generating new business opportunities to achieve or exceed revenue objectives.
* Creating and executing strategic account plans to connect Synopsys solutions with customer challenges and priorities.
* Delivering compelling sales presentations that clearly articulate the value of Synopsys products and services, using metrics and proof points.
* Building relationships with business leaders and customer executives who can champion Synopsys solutions internally.
* Coordinating sales efforts with global teams including marketing, account management, legal, and technical services.
* Developing effective proposals and quotations that address customer needs and represent maximum value.
* Alerting clients to new or improved products/services and relaying feedback to product development teams.
* Researching and identifying new prospective customers and expanding business within existing accounts.
* Leveraging trade shows, conventions, training, and seminars to enhance business development opportunities.
* Completing administrative tasks such as quotation generation, order processing, and contract preparation.
* Maintaining a healthy sales pipeline and accurately entering data into Salesforce.
* Staying knowledgeable about Synopsys’ evolving portfolio to facilitate sales efforts.


**The Impact You Will Have:**
* Driving revenue growth and expanding Synopsys’ presence in Sweden’s engineering and simulation markets.
* Helping customers unlock new levels of innovation and efficiency through adoption of advanced simulation solutions.
* Building lasting relationships with key clients, positioning Synopsys as a trusted technology partner.
* Identifying and addressing customer needs to deliver measurable ROI, fostering long-term loyalty.
* Contributing to product development by relaying valuable customer feedback and market insights.
* Enhancing the company’s reputation through exceptional service and technical expertise.
* Ensuring that sales goals and quotas are consistently achieved, supporting overall business objectives.
* Collaborating across teams to drive seamless customer experiences and successful project outcomes.


**What You’ll Need:**
* Bachelor’s degree in technical, engineering, business, or related field; alternatively, 6+ years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated success in technical sales positions, ideally within engineering simulation or software environments.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities, tracking progress and adapting to changing demands.
* Experience navigating moderately complex sales and customer issues with guidance as needed.
* Strong networking skills, capable of driving new contacts and maintaining robust business relationships.
* Fluency in English and Swedish (local language of territory).
* Willingness to travel regionally up to 50%.
* Knowledge of Synopsys products/services and pricing practices is a plus.
* Understanding of engineering analysis and technology; familiarity with sales fundamentals and strategic execution.


**Who You Are:**
* Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent communicator with strong organizational and executive presentation skills.
* Collaborative team player, able to coordinate across internal and external ecosystems.
* Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Adaptable, resilient, and eager to learn and grow professionally.


**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**
 Join a high-performing sales team focused on driving innovation and delivering engineering simulation solutions to customers across Sweden. Our team collaborates closely with marketing, technical experts, and account managers globally to provide exceptional service and support. You’ll work alongside passionate professionals dedicated to helping customers achieve their business goals through cutting-edge technology.
   

  

**Rewards and Benefits:**
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
   

  

 #Ansysjob

title: Freelance/Contract - GMP Facility management Consultant
description:
For the past 25 years, ProPharma has improved the health and wellness of patients by providing advice and expertise that empowers biotech, med device, and pharmaceutical organizations of all sizes to confidently advance scientific breakthroughs and introduce new therapies. ProPharma partners with its clients through an advise-build-operate model across the complete product lifecycle. With deep domain expertise in regulatory sciences, clinical research solutions, quality & compliance, pharmacovigilance, medical information, and R&D technology, ProPharma offers an end-to-end suite of fully customizable consulting solutions that de-risk and accelerate our partners’ most high-profile drug and device programs.
   

  

 ProPharma is supporting one of the leading Life-sciences groups globally with an interim/contract project support need based at their site in Sweden. This project requires subject matter expertise in GMP facility management within the sector which requires an immediate start. The project will run for at least 4 months and will offer full-time hours (1.0FTE) throughout the project duration. The role is mainly performed onsite just north of Solna and we are ideally looking to partner with independent consultants only.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Evaluate the current GMP facility activities and identify areas for improvement
* Lead and manage GMP facility improvement activities to ensure inspection readiness
* Review all SOP’s, work instructions etc. and update where necessary
* Provide technical support to a variety of tasks within GMP-critical system activities
* Work with other department heads to assess the current state of regulatory compliance and perform corrective changes to improve the facilities overall standard
* Act as the SME across the area and lead/support all ongoing projects where necessary
* Overall support to our client to ensure the successful completion of the project


**Necessary Skills And Abilities**
* Must be educated to at least a BSc level or higher with a life-sciences discipline
* Proven and extensive experience working within the Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology sector is a must
* Extensive experience working in GMP facility management within life-sciences at an SME level is a must
* Proven experience managing complex issues in GMP facility management and creating solutions would be highly preferred
* Thorough experience to FDA regulations would be highly advantageous
* Fluent in English (Swedish would also be desirable)
* Can work mainly office based in Uppsala throughout the project
* Must have extensive skills in problem solving, support corrective procedures and understanding key regulations to ensure compliance


 We celebrate our differences and strive to create a workplace where each person can be their authentic self. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Employees are encouraged to unleash their innovative, collaborative, and entrepreneurial spirits. With a holistic approach as an Equal Opportunity Employer, we provide a safe space where all employees feel empowered to succeed.
   

  

 All applications to roles at ProPharma are personally reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. We do not rely on AI screening tools to support our hiring process. You will always receive an outcome to your application so that you have an answer from us - whether you're successful or not.
   

  

 Whilst ProPharma supports remote working, we also recognise the value that comes from in person collaboration. As such, we encourage any new hires that are based within a reasonably short commute of one of our offices to work on a hybrid basis and spend some time working from that office location, as agreed with your manager. All applications will be treated on their own merit and candidates will not be at any advantage or disadvantage based on their proximity to an office.
   

  

 \*\*\*ProPharma Group does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters/third parties. Please, no phone calls or emails to anyone regarding this posting.\*\*\*

title: Automationsingenjör inom Life Science
description:
At
 **ABB** 
 , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

**This position reports to:**
 Engineering Manager
   

  

 \_\_
   

  

**Dina ansvarsområden**
 Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med avancerad processautomation och bidra till att utveckla framtidens Life Science‑industri. Som automationsingenjör hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team som arbetar med tekniskt komplexa projekt där ABB:s marknadsledande DCS‑plattform System 800xA står i centrum.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära projektledare och ingenjörskollegor och får följa projekten genom hela kedjan – från idé och design till idrifttagning och uppföljning på site, både i Sverige och internationellt. Här kombineras teori och praktik i projekt som gör verklig skillnad för våra kunder inom läkemedelsindustrin.
   

  

 Vi är idag cirka 65 ingenjörer på flera orter och söker nu fler kollegor som vill växa tillsammans med oss. Placeringsort är i första hand Kista, alternativt Västerås.
   

  

 I rollen ingår bland annat att:
   

  

* Ta fram funktionsspecifikationer och arbeta med systemuppsättning, -integration och programmering i vår DCS-plattform 800xA och Batch.
* Genomföra verifiering och validering (FAT), inklusive testning (SAT) hos våra kunder.
* Säkerställa att tekniska lösningar uppfyller krav på kvalitet, standarder och säkerhet.
* Samarbeta nära projektledare, ingenjörer och kunder i projekt- och teknikmöten samt vid anläggningsbesök.
* Arbeta självständigt i mindre projekt eller som del av större projektteam.


**Din bakgrund**
* Högskoleingenjörsutbildning eller högre och gärna flerårig erfarenhet av processautomation inom Life Science, livsmedel, läkemedel eller processindustri.
* Programmeringsvana och ett starkt intresse för automation och styrning av industriella processer.
* Meriterande med erfarenhet av System 800xA, batchfunktionalitet eller andra DCS‑plattformar.
* Nyfiken, målinriktad och kommunikativ – du trivs med kundkontakt och att bygga relationer.
* Förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i team.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
* Meriterande med B‑körkort.


**Mer om oss**
 Du blir en del av ABB Energy Industries inom affärsområdet Automation, där vi arbetar med kunder inom läkemedel, kemi, livsmedel samt värme-, vatten- och kärnkraftsindustrin i Sverige och Norden. Ta chansen att vara med och gör skillnad.
 *Engineered to Outrun.*
 Hos oss får du arbeta med den senaste tekniken och varierade projekt som ger både bredd och djup. Varje uppdrag innebär nya lärdomar, nya kontakter och möjligheten att bidra till innovation i en bransch som gör skillnad. ABB erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och flera förmåner, såsom flexibelt arbete, friskvårdsbidrag, extra föräldralön, arbetstidsförkortning, personalstiftelse, semesterbostäder, aktieägarprogram och förmånsportal.
   

  

 Ansök senast 16 oktober (vi arbetar med löpande urval). Frågor kring tjänsten ställs till rekryterande chef: Eva Eliopoulos, eva.eliopoulos@se.abb.com. Fackliga representanter: Sveriges Ingenjörer: Amanda Törn +46 72 464 40 66; Ledarna: Lenny Larsson +46 706 32 85 47; Unionen: Tony H Johansson +46 730 66 99 06. Övriga frågor ställs till Talent Partner Irma Leijon +46 72 461 23 14.
   

  

 Läs mer om ABB på www.abb.com.
   

  

 Vi undanber oss vänligen direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare platsannonser.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan i PDF‑format. Notera att anställningsprocessen på ABB Sverige inkluderar referenskontroll, drogtest och vid vissa rekryteringar även utökad bakgrundskontroll.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?
   

  

 Apply today or visit
 **https://www.abb.com** 
 to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: SAP Release Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 At Billerud we believe that when we have tomorrow in mind, we will do our very best today. It is thanks to our employees that we are a world-leading company within the field of renewable paper and packaging materials. Do you want to realize your true value and work for a sustainable tomorrow? Join us!
   

  

  

  

 Are you an experienced Release Manager with a passion for governance, coordination, and driving successful SAP deliveries in complex global environments? A unique opportunity to shape and develop Billerud’s future global SAP landscape in a true greenfield transformation.
   

  

  

  

 As part of Billerud's ongoing SAP transformation journey, we are looking for a Global IT SAP Release Manager to lead and coordinate releases across our SAP landscape and connected applications. This is a key role where you will ensure that changes are delivered in a structured, secure, and efficient way while minimizing business disruption and supporting long-term operational stability.
   

  

  

  

**About The Role**
 As Global IT SAP Release Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and governing releases across Billerud's SAP ecosystem, including SAP S/4HANA and connected platforms such as SAP BTP, Ariba, and integrated third-party applications.
   

  

  

  

 You will work closely with internal teams, SAP RISE operations, external application management partners, and business stakeholders to ensure successful release planning and execution.
   

  

  

  

 The role combines release governance, stakeholder management, process improvement, and operational coordination in a global environment.
   

  

  

  

**Your Main Tasks Will Be**
* Coordinate release planning and execution across SAP and integrated business applications.


  

  

* Manage release schedules, dependencies, and change windows to ensure stable and predictable deliveries.


  

  

* Act as the primary contact for release coordination with SAP RISE operations and external AMS providers.


  

  

* Lead release governance activities, including CAB participation, release approvals, cutover planning, go-live activities, and post-go-live follow-up.


  

  

* Collaborate with development, testing, operations, and business teams to secure release readiness and operational stability.


  

  

* Drive continuous improvements within release management, including automation, DevOps practices, and CI/CD adoption.


  

  

* Maintain release documentation, reporting, and communication to stakeholders across the organization.


  

  

 You report to:  Manager Global SAP Application.
   

  

 While the preferred location for this role is Solna, the position can also be based in one of our mills in Sweden. Frequent travel to our Solna office is an essential part of the role.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   

  

  

  

* At least 10 years of experience in Release Management, IT Project Management, SAP Operations, or related areas.


  

  

* Several years of experience managing releases in SAP environments, preferably within SAP S/4HANA landscapes.


  

  

* Experience working with SOLMAN and/or SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Transport Management, and ITIL-based processes.


  

  

* Experience collaborating with SAP RISE operations and external Application Management Service providers.


  

  

* Good understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automation, and agile delivery methodologies.


  

  

* ITIL certification is highly beneficial.


  

  

* SAP certifications are considered an advantage.


  

  

* Fluency in English, both written and spoken


**Personal qualities**
 You are a structured and proactive leader who thrives in complex environments with many stakeholders, dependencies, and moving parts. You have a strong ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and create clarity in situations where many activities need to come together successfully.
   

  

 You know how to build trust and strong relationships across business, IT, and external partners. With a strategic mindset and strong problem-solving skills, you can balance operational stability with the need for continuous improvement and change.
   

  

 As a person, you are collaborative, solution-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality results in a global environment.
   

  

 Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in: We care for each other and We do what we say!
   

  

 Note: You need to have a permanent Swedish work permit to be considered for this position.
   

  

**Contact**
 If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out to Katarina Kopkin, Senior Manager Global Applications; katarina.kopkin@billerud.com or if you have any questions regarding the recruitment, please contact Mimmi Jonsson, Sr TAP; mimmi.jonsson@billerud.com
   

  

**Application information**
 Selection and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis. Please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

**Do you want to help create a sustainable future through your work?**
 At Billerud, we are fully committed to reduce our and our customers carbon footprint by offering high-performance paper and packaging materials. We are convinced that the right solutions can be important tools to help fight climate change. That's why we see it as our responsibility to enable the best packaging choices, for a better tomorrow.
   

  

 Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.
   

  

 We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.
   

  

 Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

title: SAP Test Manager/Lead
description:
**Job Description**
 At Billerud we believe that when we have tomorrow in mind, we will do our very best today. It is thanks to our employees that we are a world-leading company within the field of renewable paper and packaging materials. Do you want to realize your true value and work for a sustainable tomorrow? Join us!
   

  

  

  

 Are you passionate about quality assurance, test management, and ensuring successful business transformations? A unique opportunity to shape and develop Billerud’s future global SAP landscape in a true greenfield transformation.
   

  

  

  

 As part of Billerud's SAP S/4HANA journey, we are looking for a SAP Test Manager/Lead to take overall responsibility for planning, coordinating, and executing testing activities across our SAP landscape. This is a key role where you will ensure that solutions are thoroughly tested, business requirements are met, and high-quality deliveries are achieved throughout implementation projects and ongoing application maintenance.
   

  

  

  

**About The Role**
 As SAP Test Lead, you will be part of the Global SAP Applications team and work closely with Business Process Leads, Subject Matter Experts, functional consultants, developers, solution architects, implementation partners, and other stakeholders across the organization.
   

  

  

  

 You will lead all testing activities across the SAP landscape, ensuring structured and efficient test execution throughout the project lifecycle. The role combines test strategy, test planning, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement of testing practices.
   

  

  

  

**Your Main Tasks Will Be**
* Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, including scope, approach, test methods, timelines, and resource planning.


  

  

* Lead and coordinate testing activities across SAP modules, integrated systems, and multiple project teams and Application Maintenance.


  

  

* Drive test execution through all phases, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Regression Testing, and Cutover Testing.
* Manage the defect process, including documentation, prioritization, tracking, escalation, and resolution.


  

  

* Monitor testing progress, communicate risks and issues, and provide regular status updates to project stakeholders and management.


  

  

* Ensure adherence to established testing methodologies, standards, templates, and governance frameworks while contributing to the continuous improvement of testing processes.


  

  

 You report to: Manager Global SAP Applications.
   

  

  

  

 While the preferred location for this role is Solna, the position can also be based in one of our mills in Sweden. Frequent travel to our Solna office is an essential part of the role.

* University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.


  

  

* Several years of experience working within SAP testing, quality assurance, or test management.


  

  

* Test management certification such as ISTQB or similar is highly beneficial.


  

  

* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and various testing methodologies.


  

  

* Experience working with agile delivery methodologies is considered an advantage.


  

  

* Strong understanding of end-to-end test data management and test quality assurance.


  

  

* Strong documentation skills, including experience creating test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports.


  

  

* Fluency in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.


**Personal qualities**
 Your personality
   

  

 You are structured and analytical and passionate about quality and continuous improvement. You have a strong attention to detail while maintaining a holistic view of business objectives, timelines, and stakeholder needs.
   

  

 You are an excellent communicator who can build strong relationships across functions and effectively engage both technical experts and business users.
   

  

 As a person, you are proactive, solution-oriented, and resilient under pressure. You enjoy working in collaborative and global environments and take pride in delivering high-quality results that contribute to successful business outcomes.
   

  

 Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in: We care for each other and We do what we say!
   

  

**Contact**
 If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out to Katarina Kopkin, Senior Manager Global Applicants; katarina.kopkin@billerud.com or if you have any questions regarding the recruitment, please contact Mimmi Jonsson, Sr TAP; mimmi.jonsson@billerud.com
   

  

**Application information**
 Selection and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis. Please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

**Do you want to help create a sustainable future through your work?**
 At Billerud, we are fully committed to reduce our and our customers carbon footprint by offering high-performance paper and packaging materials. We are convinced that the right solutions can be important tools to help fight climate change. That's why we see it as our responsibility to enable the best packaging choices, for a better tomorrow.
   

  

 Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.
   

  

 We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.
   

  

 Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 200,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
  
Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
  
At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!
  
DESCRIPTION
  
As a Security Engineer at Sinch, you will help safeguard our cloud and on-premise environments as an integral member of our global security team. Your focus will be on identifying potential risks, conducting vulnerability assessments, and supporting the security of our infrastructure. You will handle routine security evaluations independently while collaborating with and learning from senior engineers on more complex projects.
  
Conduct vulnerability assessments and security testing across our products and systems.
  
Proactively monitor and manage the attack surface across assigned environments, recommending and implementing mitigation strategies.
  
Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of robust cloud hardening standards to continuously improve our security posture.
  
Evaluate, deploy, and manage security tools, providing recommendations for improvements.
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security measures into DevOps processes and contribute to secure design best practices.
  
Design and implement automation for security processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  
Participate in architectural reviews to ensure security is deeply embedded in all new infrastructure initiatives.
  
Analyze emerging security threats and sharing insights and mitigation proposals with senior engineers.
  
  

This is a hybrid role based in Sweden, with Kalmar as the preferred location and Stockholm being an option.
  
REQUIREMENTS
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  
Hands-on industry experience in security engineering or a similar role.
  
Proficiency in security tools and technologies.
  
Pragmatic and analytical to problem-solving, clear communication, and good organizational skills.
  
**Preferred Certifications:** CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security - Specialty.
  
  

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
  
Must currently reside in and be eligible for employment in Sweden. Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this role.
  
OUR HIRING PROCESS
  
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
  
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

title: System Administrator
description:
**Sista ansökningsdatum: 16 oktober** 




  





 I takt med att vår IT-division på Svenska kraftnät växer ökar även enhetens uppdrag och Data- och rapportplattformen är och kommer att bli en allt viktigare del i Svenska kraftnäts satsning inom dataområdet. Vi söker en
 **Systemadministratör** 
 inom
 **Dataplattform** 
 som vill vara med på Svenska kraftnäts datadrivna resa genom att förvalta och vidareutveckla våra dataplattformar som verkligen gör skillnad för hela verksamheten.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Här blir du en del av enheten Dataanalys och dataplattform, som ansvarar för att tillhandahålla plattformar för lagring, analys och delning av data för att möjliggöra en säker och effektiv användning av data och information på hela myndigheten. Enheten svarar på frågor och beställningar om strukturerad data, exempelvis datauttag och publicerade rapporter.
 



 På enheten arbetar ett engagerat team bestående av 20 medarbetare med kompetens inom dataanalys, backend- och frontendutveckling samt IT-specialister som hanterar arkitektur, applikationsdrift och support för våra plattformar. Vi arbetar tvärfuktionellt enligt agila principer tillsammans med förvaltningsledare och produktägare med både förvaltning och vidareutveckling.
 



 I din roll som Systemadministratör kommer du att arbeta med både förvaltning och drift av våra Linuxbaserade dataplattforma. Du ansvarar för att dataplattformen fungerar optimalt och säkerställer att viktiga rapporter och analyser förses med korrekt data i rätt tid. Du ser även till att Hadoop/Cloudera-plattformen utvecklas för att kunna ta emot ännu mer data, bl.a. från nya datakällor.
 



  





 Tjänsten kommer även att innefatta:
 


* Arbete med hantering av databaser
* Arbete med anslutning av nya datakällor, felsökning, uppdateringar och uppgraderingar samt övervakning och även utveckling av dataflöden
* Att föreslå tekniska lösningar och proaktivt förbättra och vidareutveckla Linuxplattformen
* Att agera bollplank för olika intressenter t.ex. i samband med framtagande av nya IT-lösningar



  





 I rollen blir du en nyckelperson i att driva Svenska kraftnäts datadrivna utveckling och stärka verksamhetens förmåga att använda data som grund för beslut och insikter. Här får du goda möjligheter att påverka arbetssätt och lösningar inom givna ramar för verksamheten.
 



  





**Om dig** 




**Skallkrav:** 




 Vi söker dig som gillar systemadministration, Linux, lagring, prestanda, byggande av kluster, pipelines för bearbetning av data samt övervakning och larmsättning – med målet att både servrar och användare ska vara lyckliga dagarna i ända. Du har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt och navigerar lätt i komplexa miljöer. Att omsätta behov till robusta, säkra och välfungerande tekniska lösningar som skapar nytta i verksamheten motiverar dig, samtidigt som du gärna håller dig uppdaterad om den tekniska utvecklingen. Som person är du stabil och flexibel och trivs i en föränderlig miljö och du har lätt för att anpassa dig till både uppgift och tempo. Du har lätt för att kommunicera på olika nivåer, uppskattar samarbete och att åstadkomma resultat tillsammans med andra. Du är även samtidigt framåtlutad, tar egna initiativ och kan självständigt driva ditt arbete framåt.
 



 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
 



 Vidare har du en relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap, systemutveckling eller en YH-utbildning inom IT, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet eller kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som Svenska kraftnät bedömer likvärdigt.
 



  





 Du har även:
 


* Flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av förvaltning och drift av Linuxbaserade dataplattformar
* Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete i Linuxmiljöer med bl.a. scriptning
* God kännedom inom systemadministration, integration, säkerhet och test
* Goda kunskaper i Python och Bash
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift



  





 Vi ser det som
 **meriterande** 
 om du har:
 


* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med meddelandehanteringssystem ex. kafka
* Erfarenhet av Machine Learning
* Förståelse för ETL
* Erfarenhet av att hantera big data-lösningar som bygger på kluster, t.ex. Hadoop
* God erfarenhet av optimering av SQL och dataflöden samt av driftstabilitet
* Erfarenhet av verktyg för ärendehantering, versionshantering, artefakthantering samt kontinuerlig integration och driftsättning, t.ex. Azure DevOps
* Erfarenhet av DevOps och/eller DataOps



  





**Bra att veta** 



* Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm (Sundbyberg)
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %, om arbetet tillåter. #LI-hybrid.
* Resor kan förekomma i denna tjänst
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning, men provanställning kan komma att tillämpas
* I tjänsten kan schemalagd beredskap komma att ingå
* Sista ansökningsdag är den
 **16 oktober 2026**
* Vi använder urvalsfrågor istället för personligt brev, du behöver endast bifoga ditt CV skrivet på svenska
* Förmåner | Svenska kraftnät

 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Computer Sweden Recruitment. För frågor kring tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen, välkommen att kontakta huvudansvarig rekryteringskonsult Johanna Nordberg, 070 3343159 eller johanna.nordberg@csrecruitment.se. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

* Annika Ingeborn, SACO, 010 475 87 72

 Du når oss också via e-post: Förnamn.Efternamn@svk.se.
 



 Jobba här – bli en viktig del av vår energiframtid | Svenska kraftnät
