title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Detection and Response
description:
**TL;DR** 
 You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 8+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with at least 3 at staff/principal level.
* Strong engineering background - you build detections as code, not as saved searches in a SIEM.
* Deep experience with cloud telemetry (GCP/AWS/Cloudflare), endpoint EDR, identity logs, and modern SIEM/data-lake stacks (Panther, Elastic, Snowflake/Clickhouse).
* Battle-tested incident commander who has led real high-severity incidents from first alert to public post-mortem.
* Adversary-minded: comfortable with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intel, purple-teaming, and red team collaboration.
* Bonus: detection for LLM/agent abuse, prompt injection at scale, or insider risk in AI-augmented engineering orgs.


**What You'll Do**
* Build the detection engineering platform - pipelines, detections-as-code, automated triage, and response playbooks.
* Design and own security incident response process with 24/7 coverage, with a small, high-leverage human and agent team.
* Lead incidents end-to-end: detection, containment, eradication, post-mortem, and follow-through.
* Hunt proactively across corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces - and turn every finding into a durable detection.
* Define what 'world-class D&R for an AI-native company' looks like, and build it.


**Our tech stack**
* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

 Xenit is a growth company which specializes in Cloud and Modern Work. Our committed employees inspire, challenge and encourage each other, while providing extensive value for our customers. Xenit is

title: Var med och forma framtidens teknik på Saab!
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
 Tekniken utvecklas snabbare än någonsin. AI förändrar hur vi arbetar, data skapar nya möjligheter och mjukvara blir alltmer avgörande för framtidens produkter och system. På Saab är du inte bara med och följer utvecklingen, du är en del av den.
   

  

 Vi befinner oss på en transformativ tillväxtresa med stora satsningar inom AI, Data, R&D och Software Factory. Här utvecklar vi teknik som stärker samhällen, ökar säkerheten och gör skillnad på riktigt. Nu vill vi komma i kontakt med dig som vill vara med och forma framtidens lösningar tillsammans med oss.
   

  

***Din roll***
 Bredden på tekniken inom Saab är unik. Här kan du vara med och utveckla allt från mjukvara, data- och AI-lösningar till komplexa system som möjliggör kommunikation, informationsdelning, beslutsfattande, situationsuppfattning och operativ förmåga i kritiska miljöer.
   

  

 Det innebär möjligheten att arbeta i teknikens framkant, nära några av branschens främsta specialister, och bidra till lösningar som möter verkliga utmaningar i luften, på marken, till sjöss och under vattenytan.
   

  

***Din profil***
 Vi söker särskilt dig med erfarenhet inom:
   

  

* Data & AI
* Mjukvaruutveckling
* Systemingenjörsarbete
* Teknisk ledning av komplexa system och mjukvarulösningar


 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet inom något av våra fokusområden och drivs av att lösa komplexa problem tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken på ny teknik, vill fortsätta utvecklas och trivs i en miljö där kunskapsdelning, samarbete och ständig förbättring är en naturlig del av vardagen.
   

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*
***Vad du blir en del av***
 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 26,100 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.
   

  

**Välkommen till Saab. Där innovation möter mening, och där framtidens teknik byggs varje dag.**

title: Shift Leader Front Office Scandic Upplands Väsby, heltid
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 18 oktober 2026
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

**Scandic Upplands Väsby** är det hemtrevliga hotellet och ligger beläget jämte motorvägen mellan centrala Stockholm och Arlanda flygplats. Våra gäster är allt ifrån klassiska affärsresenärer, till fyrbenta vänner och sportande ungdomar. Ingen dag är den andra lik och vi har oftast fullt hus! Även om hotellet är litet till storleken har vi mycket att erbjuda både våra gäster och medarbetare. Vi som arbetar här är en stor familj som månar om varandras utveckling. Hos oss finns det, förutom de bästa kollegorna, även många kurser och utvecklingsmöjligheter för våra anställda. Värnar du lika mycket om dina kollegor som vi gör? Då är du den vi söker!



**Nu söker vi en Shift Leader till Scandic Upplands Väsby.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Som Shift Leader agerar du värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Under din tid hos oss kan dessa områden variera i takt med att du och affären utvecklas. Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad innebär rollen som Shift Leader Front Office?**



Du som arbetar inom Front Office är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning. Arbetet i Front Office innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet.



I rollen som Shift Leader har du, förutom att vara en del av driften, den övergripande överblicken över gästflödet och ser tillsammans med teamet till att prioritera arbetsuppgifter så att verksamheten flyter så att gästerna blir nöjda. Du leder och fördelar arbetet och hanterar bemanningen under ditt arbetspass. Vid behov får du utbilda nya medarbetare på hotellet och du avlastar också Front Office Manager med vissa administrativa arbetsuppgifter.



Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Din kompetens**



För den här rollen krävs att du har både förmåga och vilja att arbeta med ett driftsnära ledarskap. Du är trygg i ditt ledarskap och har både integritet och säljdriv. För att passa i rollen tror vi också att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster. Du är en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.



Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


**Information om tjänsten:**



Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid.


Vi söker dig som tycker om att ta ansvar och som trivs med att ha en ledande roll i teamet. Du är en person som peppar och stöttar dina kollegor, delar med dig av din kunskap och gärna hjälper till att hitta lösningar när utmaningar uppstår.



Som Shift Leader arbetar du nära receptionschefen och är en viktig del i att skapa struktur, engagemang och en positiv känsla i det dagliga arbetet. Du leder genom att vara närvarande, visa vägen och inspirera teamet att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans.



Startdatum 01 november.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.



Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!


Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Sales Manager Nexus BIX- Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
Gothenburg, Sweden


* Full-time
* Sales and Business Development
* Onsite
* Tieto Indtech

  
Job Description **Senior Sales Manager Multichannel & BIX - Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**


Are you ready to make an impact? Are you looking for an opportunity in one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? We have a great opportunity available now in our team.


We are looking for a **Senior** **Sales Manager to join Tieto Indtech and drive new business growth within our BIX and Multichannel business in Sweden**.


This is a **new business sales role**. Your primary responsibility will be to identify prospective customers, create and develop opportunities, and lead them from initial engagement through to a signed agreement.


You will sell solutions that help organizations digitalize and automate how they exchange invoices and business documents with their customers, suppliers and other business partners. Our offering includes both **B2B and B2C invoice and document distribution**, from electronic invoicing and invoice collection to multichannel distribution and related value-added services.


You will work with large and mid-sized organizations across different industries and engage with stakeholders in finance, IT, procurement and business operations.


In this Sales Manager role, you will be part of the Nordic sales team as opportunities are discovered. You will work closely with colleagues across Sweden and the Nordics, and you will receive training and support based on our shared knowledge and experience from different Nordic markets. We are always open to new ideas and believe continuous development and learning are important, and you will play an important role in our sales development.

 **In your daily work you get to**

* Be Senior Sales Manager focusing on hunting new sales for our services
* Proactively identify and target prospective customers and build a strong pipeline
* Lead generation activities together with marketing
* Participate in events, fairs etc with the purpose of learning more about our customers need and find new leads
* Engage with prospects to understand their invoicing, finance and document distribution processes, identify their challenges and development priorities.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, and contract signing.
* Coordinate, together with Presales and BID-manager, internal experts from product management, solution consulting, delivery, legal, finance and other functions throughout the sales process
* Lead and coordinate responses to RFIs, RFPs and other formal procurement processes
* Bring market and prospect insights back to our product and business teams to support the continued development of our offering and go-to-market approach

  

**To enjoy working with us in this role, we believe that you:**


* Have solution sales experience, and are used to agile working methods
* Are motivated by creating opportunities and winning new customers
* Come with experience of technology, financial processes, invoicing, ERP, business process services or a related fields
* Have a pro-active attitude and way of working
* Can handle multiple sales processes simultaneously
* Are fluent in Swedish and English

 **What Multichannel & BIX offers you**


We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture and an outstanding work-life balance! We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge. Tieto offers local proximity with global capabilities. You get to be part of a community of professionals, a community of friends**.**  



**In addition, we offer:**

* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits, adapted to the Swedish market
* Mobile package and, depending on role and eligibility, company car or related mobility benefits
* Wellness allowance and other local wellbeing initiatives
* Family-friendly policies, including support for work-life balance and parental leave
* Occupational pension, employee discounts, referral bonuses and additional lifestyle benefits

  

**Join us and make your mark!**

We look forward to your application!  

Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact hiring manager Carin Ramsin via e-mail carin.ramsin@tieto.com

  

Additional Information  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

  
We provide customers across different industries with mission-critical solutions through our specialized software businesses Tieto Caretech, Tieto Banktech and Tieto Indtech as well as Tieto Tech Consulting business.


Our around 14 000 talented vertical software, design, cloud and AI experts are dedicated to empowering our customers to succeed and innovate with latest technology.


Tieto’s annual revenue is approximately EUR 2 billion. The company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.*
 We’re looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 to join our growing team in Stockholm. You might be a data enthusiast with a couple of years under your belt or already a more seasoned professional. What matters most to us is your willingness to keep learning, take ownership, and work on solutions that create clear business value.
   

  

 In this role, you will work on a variety of cloud-based customer projects, designing and building modern data platforms and analytics solutions using Azure Data Platform services, Databricks, and AI-enabled tools. Your work may include data modelling, integrations, and architectural design, always in close collaboration with customers and internal experts. You will also be part of Norrin’s Data Engineering Guild, a community where knowledge is shared, skills are developed together, and people actively support each other’s growth.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 2-5 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in analytics solution development
* Experience building Databricks and/or Fabric-based solutions in an Azure environment
* Understanding of data warehousing, data modelling, and integrations
* Good collaboration skills and a customer-oriented mindset
* Curiosity and initiative to keep learning new things and stay up to date
* Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly, also to non-technical stakeholders
* Fluency in Swedish and English
* Strong skills in SQL and Python/PySpark
* Experience building data pipelines using Databricks, dbt, Microsoft Fabric or similar
* Solid understanding of data security and privacy principles
* Experience with dimensional modelling
* Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD principles


**Nice to have**
* Experience with Power BI and automated reporting
* Experience with GenAI or machine learning, including MLOps
* Understanding and/or experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake


**Why Norrin?**
 At Norrin, you'll join an
 **international team** 
 of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The
 **diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges** 
 keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.
   

  

 We invest in
 **continuous learning** 
 through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster
 **a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect** 
 , with psychological safety at its core
 **.** 
 We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.
   

  

 Our
 **hybrid working model** 
 combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer
 **wellbeing benefits** 
 like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our
 **competitive compensation model** 
 offers a fixed salary model or a hybrid model including base salary and a performance-based bonus.
   

  

**Could this be your next opportunity?**
 We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

title: Sales Development Representative - Inbound
description:
**Job Description**
 Do you bring commercial curiosity and enjoy working as part of a team? If you are interested in technology and eager to learn, this role offers a supportive setting to develop practical skills alongside a collaborative SDR team.
   

  

**Why work at Oracle**
* Competitive salary with exciting benefits
* Hybrid working: three days per week in office
* Health insurance and pension contributions
* 30 days’ annual leave, + extra paid days
* Mentorship, structured learning programs, and an annual education budget
* Wellbeing activities
* Employee resource groups that champion diverse communities
* Inclusive, collaborative culture that values different perspectives


**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do**
 Match customers' business challenges to Oracle solutions, collaborating with sales and marketing on campaigns that support business growth. Engage new and existing customers by phone, email, and social selling.
   

  

* Identify sales opportunities in new and existing accounts
* Use online apps to understand and connect with clients
* Make calls to customers and prospects
* Set up customer meetings and create sales pipeline
* Build core communication, research, and social selling skills through learning and coaching
* Analyze data to improve customer outreach
* Work to meet and exceed quarterly objectives
* Build stakeholder engagement skills through collaboration with sales, marketing, and customer teams.
* Stay curious, organised, and ready to learn .


**Job Spec**
**Location:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Working pattern:** 
 Hybrid: Tue/Wed/Thu in office
   

  

**Focus:** 
 New business opportunities in the Nordics
   

  

**About Oracle**
 Oracle is a technology leader changing how the world does business. In this role, you’ll help power growth and create the future.
   

  

**Inclusion**
 At Oracle, we don’t just respect differences — we celebrate them. Innovation starts with inclusion, and everyone’s voice should be heard and valued.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level - IC1
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior Partner Sales Manager
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**Partner Account Manager Senior - Nordics**
 Are you a consultative SaaS sales professional responsible for driving revenue growth and bringing in net new business from partners, prospects and current customers? As a Sr. Partner Account Manager, you will work to help expand our industry-leading partner ecosystem.  The Partner team is responsible for opening new routes to market by helping partners build and sell customer experience offers at speed and scale and grow strategic partner relationships.
   

  

**Major focus areas of this role are:** 
  

  

* Manage the sale of Genesys solutions through named partners and opportunities.
* Drive a business plan that allows us to scale our solution sales with partners.
* Drive strategic enablement of Partners to attract, develop and maintain relationships with various key partners and throughout the entire customer journey lifecycle.
* Build preference for Genesys customer experience and services within partners’ portfolios and sales teams.
* Drive sales results and pipeline development within key partners working closely with sales and alliances to close customer opportunities, manage forecasts and pipelines.
* Strategic expansion of partners to accelerate growth, by recruiting and gaining the commitment of targeted partner relationships.
* Deliver and execute viable joint partner business and marketing plans to achieve growth.
* Align closely with the direct sales teams to provide partner visibility internally and externally.
* Structure and negotiate partnership agreements that lead to incremental value and capabilities.
* Develop detailed operational plans with partners to include engagement models, sales targets, and GTM strategies.


**We look for individuals who have a proven track record of over-achieving and who like to WIN!**
**Why work for Genesys?** 
  

  

* You have the opportunity to drive the business through accurate forecasting and strategic partner planning.
* You have the opportunity to create dynamic sales presentations working with industry best technical experts and educating your partner community.
* You will have a unique opportunity to understand our customer's strategies and help drive sales using our unique solutions.
* You will have the ability to own and develop your territory working closely with Genesys colleagues to achieve shared success.
* Demonstrate your proven abilities to create relationships with executives, stakeholders, and key influencers with both partners and customers.
* Work for a Magic Quadrant leader with a focus on AI innovations.


**What do you need to have?** 
  

  

* Proven experience communicating, negotiating, and closing with executives and stakeholders
* Proven experience understanding customer and partner needs and being able to articulate solutions
* Increase your pipeline within current and recruited partners
* 5+ years of sales experience (Cloud or SaaS based software sales preferred)
* Fluency in Swedish and English
* Demonstrable ability to lead a complex sales cycle, with a track record of successful revenue attainment
* BS or BA degree or equivalent work-related work experience
* Ability to travel up to 50%


**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys


 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
   

  

**What Happens After You Apply**
 After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
   

  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps


 Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.
   

  

**Stay Connected**
 Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.
   

  

 Get notified about relevant opportunities.
   

  

**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**
**Employee Referral**
 If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.
   

  

**About Genesys:**
 Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodations:**
 If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com.
   

  

 You can expect a response within 24–48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email.
   

  

 This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.
   

  

**Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics.**
*Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.*

title: ServiceNow Developer på B3 Now
description:
Är du en vass ServiceNow-utvecklare som vill vara med och forma framtiden i ett snabbväxande specialistbolag?
   

  

**B3 Now** 
 är en del av B3 Consulting Group och ett av koncernens nyare specialistbolag med fullt fokus på ServiceNow. Här arbetar du i en start-up-liknande miljö där energi, innovation och nyfikenhet präglar vardagen. Hos oss bygger du moderna applikationer, utvecklar smarta lösningar och skapar verkligt affärsvärde för våra kunder.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som
 **ServiceNow Developer** 
 hos B3 Now blir du en viktig del av ett team av erfarna ServiceNow-specialister. Du arbetar i projekt och uppdrag med hög påverkan hos både nationella och internationella kunder inom bl.a. tillverkning, retail, finans, energi, telekom och offentlig sektor.
   

  

 Du kommer att utveckla, konfigurera och förbättra lösningar på ServiceNow-plattformen. Rollen är teknisk och hands-on, med stort fokus på programmering, modern utveckling och kvalitetssäkring.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Utveckla lösningar i ServiceNow med moderna kodningsmetoder och enligt best practice.
* Arbeta med Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Scripted REST APIs och andra automatiserings- och integrationskomponenter.
* Utveckla användargränssnitt, formulär och logik genom både low-code och custom code.
* Översätta funktionella krav till tekniska lösningar.
* Samarbeta nära kundens verksamhet för att skapa värdeskapande lösningar.
* Bidra med teknisk rådgivning i utvecklings- och arkitekturfrågor.


 Vi söker dig som är en utvecklarprofil med stark teknisk grund och intresse för både kod och affär.
   

  

**Vidare ser vi att du har följande kvalifikationer:**
* Relevant akademisk examen eller motsvarande.
* 3–5 års erfarenhet av ServiceNow-utveckling, inklusive hands-on programmering.
* Erfarenhet av JavaScript, REST, SOAP, Scripted REST APIs samt arbete med XML/JSON.
* Erfarenhet av ServiceNow-moduler och relevanta certifieringar (ex.CAD, CIS).
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.
* En analytisk, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad approach.
* Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat, tänka kreativt och hantera komplexa tekniska utmaningar.


**Vi erbjuder:**
* Attraktiv och flexibel lönemodell.
* Möjlighet att påverka dina arbetstider och arbetsplats.
* Utbildningar för din professionella utveckling.
* En stark wellness-satsning genom Team B3, som främjar både hälsa och arbetsglädje.
* Kollegor med höga ambitioner och olika bakgrunder – ett inkluderande och internationellt mindset.
* En utmanande roll med stora möjligheter att växa tekniskt och professionellt.
* En kultur där vi både levererar värde till våra kunder och har roligt tillsammans.
* Möjlighet att påverka, bidra och vara med och forma framtiden för B3 Now.


**Om B3**
 På B3 Now tror vi på att kombinera yrkesstolthet med glädje. Vi drivs av att göra skillnad – både för våra kunder och våra kollegor. Vi bygger en miljö där lärande, samarbete och utveckling står i centrum, och där du får utrymme att växa i den riktning du vill.
   

  

 Vi investerar i din kompetens genom utbildningar, mentorprogram och kontinuerlig coaching. Vi tror att när du utvecklas, utvecklas även vi.
   

  

 B3 Now är en del av B3 Consulting Group, ett av Sveriges snabbast växande konsultbolag. Med kontor i Sverige, Norge och Polen och internationella samarbeten hjälper vi organisationer att maximera värdet av ServiceNow genom smarta, skalbara och effektiva lösningar.
   

  

 Vi är över 1000 specialister globalt i koncernen – och växer snabbt. Hos oss får du både tryggheten av en stor aktör och närheten i ett mindre bolag där du har stort inflytande.
   

  

**Kontakt** 
 Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär? Ansök nu! Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Stefan Saarnak på +46 76 725 7059

title: Internal IT Support – Parental Leave Cover
description:
Svea Solar is entering an exciting new phase of sustainable growth. Following a transformation that has already delivered strong results, Svea Solar is steadily strengthening its profitability and operational efficiency, creating a solid foundation as a leading company within Energy Solutions.
   

  

 In short, we are maturing as a company. We are aiming to become the trusted energy partner for our customers, lowering energy bills for thousands of European households. This also means strengthening our position within Internal IT.
   

  

 We're now looking for an Internal IT Support Specialist to join our four-person Internal IT team on a parental leave cover from November 2, 2026, until July 30, 2027.
   

  

 The team and the role
   

  

 Your days will be varied. Very varied. We're a high-paced environment, so you'll need to be comfortable switching between different tasks and occasionally rolling up your sleeves to handle the less glamorous stuff too.
   

  

 One moment, you might be making sure a meeting room works before an important presentation. The next, you're troubleshooting a laptop, managing a support ticket, helping with access rights, or escalating an issue to colleagues working with CRM, ERP or Data & Analytics.
   

  

 This is a parental leave cover, but we want your time with us to be valuable beyond the assignment. Your main focus will be providing internal IT support, with the opportunity to broaden your skills and take on additional responsibilities over time. So depending on your performance and interests, you may also get exposure to areas such as infrastructure, IAM, IT security, networking and hardware.
   

  

 Are we a match?
   

  

 You don't need ten years of experience. In fact, we're more interested in your attitude and willingness to learn.
   

  

**What Matters Is That You**
* Have an IT education, either from high school or further education
* Have previous experience working with IT support
* Have experience with ticket management, using Jira or a similar system
* Have hands-on experience with computers and hardware
* Have a strong level of English, both written and spoken
* Are comfortable working from our office 4 days per week


 It would be a plus if you have experience with:
   

  

* Microsoft Admin Center, Entra ID, Azure and/or IAM
* If you are interested in continuing to grow within IT at Svea Solar, it is a plus if you have experience or a strong interest in areas such as APIs and integrations, PowerShell or other scripting, automation/low-code, or practical use of AI.


**As a Person, You**
* Are service-minded, friendly and genuinely enjoy helping people. You are structured, accurate and goal-oriented. You stay calm and constructive when things get busy. You are prestigeless and willing to take on everything from the simplest support task to more complex IT challenges.


 Don’t worry if you don’t tick every box - nobody does. If this sounds like you, hit apply 😊 With us, you’ll power up and gain new skills along the way!
   

  

 🌍 Life as a Power Shifter - What do we offer you
   

  

**The opportunity to make an impact** 
 – your work directly contributes to fixing the planet and driving the energy transition.
   

  

**About**
**A value-driven workplace** 
 – read more about our values here.
   

  

**The chance to own your results** 
 – grow, take responsibility, and power up as both we and the energy industry evolve.
   

  

**Diversity and inclusivity** 
 – different perspectives drive innovation. Here, you can be yourself and contribute with your experiences, identities, and ideas.
   

  

**Employment benefits** 
 – occupational pension, 30 days of vacation, wellness allowance, free parking, and more.
   

  

 Want to see what life at Svea Solar really looks like? Follow us on Instagram: @LifeAtSveaSolar
   

  

 ⚡ Who are we
   

  

 As Sweden’s - and one of Europe’s - leading providers of energy tech and solar, we help our customers optimize their energy use with smart, connected solutions. From solar panels to heat pumps, batteries, EV chargers, and software, we’re shaping the future of energy. We call it
 **The Power Shift** 
 . And the ones driving it?
 **Power Shifters** 
 .
   

  

  

  

**About Our Recruitment Process**
* With structured interviews and assessments through Alva Labs, we make sure our recruitment process is fair, inclusive, and unbiased - because diversity is key to innovation!
* Read more about our Recruitment process here.


 👉
 **Ready to become a Power Shifter?** 
 We review applications on a rolling basis, so don’t wait to send yours in!

title: Business Unit Manager - IBM
description:
**Why Choose TD SYNNEX**
**TD SYNNEX** 
 is a
 **Fortune 500 IT company** 
 and one of the world's largest technology distributors, with
 **22,000 employees** 
 operating across more than
 **100 countries** 
 . We help businesses maximize the value of technology through innovative solutions, services, and partnerships.
   

  

**About The Role**
 IBM is a strategic growth vendor for TD SYNNEX across Europe. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the expansion of our IBM portfolio, helping partners accelerate their digital transformation through innovative IBM solutions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Define and execute the long-term business strategy and annual plans for IBM solutions and services across Europe.
* Own the business P&L, managing revenue, profitability, budgets, investments, forecasts, and resource allocation.
* Lead senior-level relationships with IBM, aligning strategic priorities and driving successful go-to-market execution.
* Shape the future direction of the IBM hardware and software portfolio, identifying growth opportunities, target markets, and partner segments.
* Drive commercial execution through effective management of pipeline, forecasting, partner development, renewals, strategic opportunities, and demand-generation activities.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Sales, Business Development, Product Management, Technical Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.
* Establish governance frameworks, performance reviews, accountability measures, and operating rhythms that support business objectives.
* Provide senior leadership with clear forecasts, business insights, risk assessments, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Lead, coach, and develop managers and specialists, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture.


**What We're Looking For**
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience in B2B sales, business development, business unit management, or operations within the IT industry.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology solutions; experience with IBM software, infrastructure, services, or comparable vendor portfolios is highly desirable.
* Proven track record of managing P&L performance, budgets, forecasting, investments, and resource planning.
* Strong strategic and commercial mindset with the ability to translate market insights and vendor strategies into actionable business plans.
* Deep understanding of the European IT channel ecosystem, including distributors, resellers, systems integrators, managed service providers, and vendor partnerships.
* Demonstrated success in building, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams across multiple functions, countries, or regions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills with senior vendor, partner, and internal leadership audiences.
* Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken; additional European languages are considered an advantage.


**What We Offer**
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities with clear career progression paths.
* Hybrid work (2 - 3 days at the office per week)
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, paid leave, retirement plans
* Certified Workplace Excellence: Work for a certified Great Place to Work organization.


 At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
   

  

**What's In It For You?**
* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.


**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**
 At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!
